column3: Emissions trading (power-sector share of UK auction revenue)
column6: The power sector's share of UK ETS emissions was taken as 30.4 of 85.6 MtCO2e. No published source gives 30.4 Mt: DESNZ's Functioning of the UK carbon market, 2024 (section 7.3) gives 29,484,524 tCO2e of 85,634,344, a share of 34.43% rather than 35.51%. The 2022 denominator was likewise held as 110.0 Mt against a published 110.6 Mt, and 2023 was held at the 2023 report's 37.1 Mt after DESNZ restated it to 36,084,695 tCO2e. Revenue for 2024 now uses the published calendar-year auction total (£2,564,090,000 across 25 auctions) instead of converting a financial-year accounts figure. 2022 and 2023 also move, to £2,635.4m and £1,270.7m. Found during primary-source checking, not reported by a reader.
